verdict.rationale: Pulley documents let users download the cap table as an Excel file at any point in time or historically, which is an open, portable format — a real but partial data-export capability. There is no evidence of a full data export (documents, stakeholder records, agreements, vesting history) or an account-closure/leave workflow. Missing for 10: full-account export beyond cap table, export of uploaded documents/agreements, explicit 'leave/close account' process, and open-format guarantees for non-spreadsheet data.
